title: Night 2: Three Reward Walkthroughs, Pillar Puzzle and Pumpkin Tasks
summary: Written routes now cover Witches Brew-nado, Reeling Petal Garland and Fuwatty Side Satchel. Crown availability remains a separate, unverified shop claim.
body: The complete WaffleTrades Night 2 video was reviewed using its in-page transcript and gameplay frames. Three task guides and three reward pages now explain the objectives, completion triggers and separate hub claims. These are REPORTED walkthroughs, not our own account playtests.

Floor 2 requires matching six linked pillars, pulling the lever, taking the relic and returning to the elevator. Dandy’s World requires 200 event pumpkins; AO ONI Nightmare requires 50 and a Floor 2 reward-room interaction.

The AO ONI recording shows a banana-shaped reward display while reporting the satchel claim. The guide warns readers to check the room and inventory result. The Crown segment announces 20 Tickets but does not demonstrate a successful purchase, so it is not listed as currently claim-verified.

title: Nine Official Livestream Times Verified; Hunted Reward Note Corrected
summary: All nine creator sessions are now verified through Roblox’s event API, with UTC and Beijing times. The rewards page now identifies the confirmed Candy Collector badge.
body: Roblox’s public virtual-events API returned nine public livestream records for The Hollow. All are hosted by Roblox Presents, group 4111519, and point to universe 10770728771 and place 116463962153167. The games page now presents the complete scheduled-start table with individual official event links.

The first listed session, Seek x NO_DATA, starts October 23 at 18:00 UTC, or October 24 at 02:00 Beijing. The last, Piggy x KreekCraft, is listed for October 31 at 16:30 UTC, or November 1 at 00:30 Beijing. Seconds are omitted for readability; raw timestamps remain preserved.

These are scheduled livestream times. They do not verify actual broadcasts, the daily order of monster unlocks, new maze availability or the finale start. Every record currently gives a 30-minute window; this is not a measured stream duration.

The rewards page previously described the Hunted badge ID as unconfirmed. That stale statement is corrected to Candy Collector, Badge ID 1253232809160660, with a link to the existing task checklist. The official API was re-read: its wording still alternates between more than 75 and 75 candies. Tickets payout and any separate avatar-item reward remain unverified.

title: Night 1 Rewards: Tickets, Claim Steps and Four Quest Guides
summary: Written guides now cover the first avatar-shop rewards, the relic maze, DOORS, Flee the Facility and a 15-minute Tickets task. Plus-only items are separated from earned rewards.
body: October 23 gameplay reviews now document five reward entries and four task guides. Official API reads establish the hub universe, reward badges and two Roblox-created catalog items; gameplay steps are attributed to the original creators rather than presented as our own playtest.

Tickets are credited from event badges when returning to the hub. Use Confirm, then enter the cinema and open the right-hand concession shop. Gourdlord: The Entangled costs 100 Tickets; Quack-o-Lantern costs 20 Tickets and requires Roblox Plus. Purchases reduce the balance. Game menu payouts vary: do not assume every badge gives 20 Tickets.

The written quest guides cover five purple relics and the Floor 1 vault, DOORS’ 50-door Candy Vault escape, Flee the Facility’s 100 deposited candies plus survivor escape, and Clean all the Leaves’ 15-minute Halloween map requirement. Layouts and early-server credit problems can vary.

No working redemption code for the official Hollow event was verified in the announcement, hub description or reviewed gameplay. Search results for Bleach-inspired HOLLOW reroll codes are a different game; we have not presented them as event codes.

title: The Hollow Official Roblox Hub Link and Place ID Confirmed
summary: The official Newsroom links to The Hollow by Roblox Presents. Its description confirms cross-experience quests and lists an additional start time with an unexplained meaning.
body: Roblox’s October 21 Newsroom announcement links directly to The Hollow, Place ID 116463962153167. The experience names Roblox Presents as publisher and links to group 4111519. We followed this evidence chain on October 23.

Public opening remains October 22 at 2 p.m. PDT (21:00 UTC; October 23 at 05:00 Beijing), with Plus access at noon PDT. The hub description separately gives a 3 p.m. PT start (22:00 UTC; October 23 at 06:00 Beijing). It does not explain the phase this refers to, so this is not a verified daily quest unlock time.

The hub description confirms that event quests in The Hollow and participating experiences can earn avatar items. Individual objectives, daily monster order, Tickets mechanics and item claim requirements remain unverified.
The verified link establishes the official destination, not successful gameplay access. Universe ID, live server availability and regional entry behavior have not been independently verified.

title: The Hollow Expands Beyond Nine Games: Full Poster, Outskirts and Hunted Badge
summary: Roblox’s full poster separates nightly encounters, everyday roaming monsters and cross-game side quests. Hunted’s developer confirms a special event badge.
body: Roblox’s full lineup poster, posted October 21 at 20:00 UTC and reviewed directly October 22, names three distinct categories. The nine main monster origins are the Nightly Haunts; they are not the entire event lineup. The games page now lists all three categories.

The nightly creator pairings are Bundun with The Deer, Kat with Animal Hospital’s Mimic, LimaMosca with Twisted Dandy, Vanilbean and Kreative Kyle with Biter, NO_DATA with Seek, KreekCraft with Piggy, ItsJustNicholas with The Inspector, Kim Left Arm with Hiachi, and SirDapper with The Overseer. No dated daily order appears on the poster.

The roaming category includes BEAR, PETAPETA, Flee the Facility, Survive the Killer, Dead Rails, Evade, Home Alone: Anomalies, Banana Eats and Aooni Nightmare. The poster describes these as everyday encounters. The Outskirts is explicitly a cross-Roblox side-quest category; its full printed lineup is now on the games and quests pages.

Dark Deception’s official account separately confirms a Hunted event quest with a special badge. We verified Hunted’s Place ID 136431686349723, Universe ID 7229780065 and publisher through Roblox. The public API returned 29 badges with no explicit Hollow match, so the quest briefing supplies the correct game entry and confirmed reward type without inventing an objective or badge ID.

Our quests page also links timestamped environment shots from Roblox’s 24-second trailer. These are preview landmarks, not a continuous maze solution. Creator video and livestream checks did not establish a usable spawn-to-exit route in the material inspected.

A separate REPORTED guide on the rewards page explains the theme-setting steps demonstrated by KreekCraft. Its account rollout and device availability have not been independently tested. This setting is separate from avatar UGC and the Hunted badge.

title: Roblox Confirms The Hollow Start Time, Nine Monsters, Rewards and Finale
summary: The October 21 Newsroom announcement confirms a shared survival hub, a 2 p.m. Pacific launch on October 22 and nine monster/game pairings. Reviewed October 22.
body: Roblox’s official announcement supplies the launch schedule and event format. Public access starts October 22 at 2 p.m. PDT (21:00 UTC; October 23 at 05:00 Beijing time). Active Roblox Plus subscribers can enter the hub two hours earlier, at noon PDT (19:00 UTC; October 23 at 03:00 Beijing time).

The Hollow takes place in a shared survival hub with changing mazes, clues and a new monster each day over nine days. The nine featured games supply monsters; the announcement does not establish nine separate original-game quest chains. The games directory records each confirmed monster pairing. Daily monster order and walkthroughs remain unverified.

Quest completion can earn UGC and survival rewards. Marketplace products, including Hollow Horseman, and paid Plus benefits are separate categories. Specific item IDs, prices and individual claim requirements are not verified here.

The live finale is scheduled for the morning of October 31, with no exact hour published. Reward collection continues until November 2 at noon PST: 20:00 UTC, or November 3 at 04:00 Beijing time. Pacific time changes from PDT to PST on November 1; the reward cutoff is distinct from the finale.

The event targets ages 9 and above in most regions; access varies by region. Creators will stream clues during the event. The announcement does not provide a verified hub Place ID, Universe ID, badge list or catalog list.

This review supersedes earlier launch-time and reported-lineup summaries. Historical reviews remain dated records. The nine linked original Roblox experience pages were read; existing Universe IDs retain their earlier identity-check dates and were not rechecked through the API in this review.

title: October 22 Confirmed: Roblox’s Original Date and Nine-Names Posts Verified
summary: Direct reads of Roblox’s X posts confirm The Hollow name and October 22 date. The launch hour, event hub, reward rules and redacted-name solution remain unverified.
body: On October 21, we directly opened Roblox’s verified X post carrying the date 10.22.26. We also read its separate nine-names post, which explicitly names The Hollow and October 22. The event name and calendar date now move from REPORTED to CONFIRMED in this guide. This is a change in our verification status, not a new postponement or launch announcement.

The date teaser is post 2108961492187918378. Our older retained source, post 2108226475573096953, is a different teaser. We now cite the date-bearing original directly so readers can distinguish the two. Earlier source reviews remain available as historical records.

The nine-names post contains nine numbered redacted entries. Its wording does not explain a daily unlock schedule, establish the event’s end date, or provide a complete puzzle solution. We have added a dedicated clue briefing that separates the visible promotional text from unverified passwords and QR-code claims.

Neither of these posts supplies a launch hour, time zone, playable hub URL or reward requirements. Game identities and the previously located Instagram artwork remain available in the games directory; participation labels are unchanged until explicit game-level evidence is checked.

title: Roblox’s Nine Original Instagram Teasers Located
summary: The original October 17 character posts are now accessible. View the official artwork and source links; game associations remain REPORTED while explicit participation evidence is pending.
body: Our October 19 follow-up reached Roblox’s verified Instagram profile in a browser and opened all nine original character reels. The profile dates them October 17, 2026, and their cover images form a The Hollow mosaic. This directly verifies the existence of the official teaser series, improving on our earlier mirror-only review.

Each original post below has a visible short caption. Expanding captions prompts sign-in, and the accessible text does not explicitly name the nine experiences. The game labels remain reported associations based on the earlier Bloxy News and RTC coverage; identifying a character in promotional art is not enough to independently confirm every game’s participation.

We have added the official cover artwork with links to the original posts. These are promotional images, not gameplay screenshots or reward previews. The confirmed games directory remains empty while explicit participation announcements, official experience identities, hub access, quests, badges and rewards await verification.

title: Nine Games Reported for Roblox The Hollow Following Instagram Teasers
summary: Bloxy News and RTC name nine experiences and point to Roblox Instagram teasers. The lineup remains REPORTED while the original posts await direct verification.
body: Follow-up on October 19: we have now opened the nine original Roblox Instagram reels in a browser. See our newer source review, Roblox’s Nine Original Instagram Teasers Located, for direct links and cover artwork. The accessible captions still do not explicitly name all nine experiences, so the lineup remains REPORTED. The following paragraphs record the earlier mirror-based review.

Bloxy News and RTC report that Roblox published Instagram character teasers for The Hollow. During our October 19, 2026 review, we read both accounts’ reporting through Sotwe public mirrors. Roblox’s original Instagram posts could not be directly accessed, so the lineup remains REPORTED rather than independently confirmed.

The reported games are DOORS, Demonology, Animal Hospital, Scary Shawarma Kiosk, Warden, Piggy, Dandy’s World, 99 Nights in the Forest, and The Mimic. Bloxy News abbreviates 99 Nights in the Forest to 99 Nights; RTC uses the longer name. These are reported experience names, not verified game links or IDs.

The supplied monitoring reports place this coverage around October 17–18. The mirrors show relative timestamps; exact original publication times and permanent links to the nine Instagram videos have not been verified. Both accounts point to Instagram, but their reports may rely on the same material and do not constitute separate official confirmations.

October 22 remains the reported start date. An exact launch time, end date, official event hub, participation requirements, quests, badges and reward items still require primary evidence. The nine-game report does not establish a nine-night schedule.

This update records a stronger reporting lead than the earlier character speculation. The confirmed games directory remains unchanged. We will add game links and playable guides after verifying participation, experience IDs and actual instructions against Roblox or developer announcements.

title: October 13 source review: conflicting dates and the DOORS lead
summary: New media sources add context, but conflicting end dates and an unverified DOORS link leave the event details unchanged.
body: Our October 13, 2026 review directly read new secondary reports from Pro Game Guides, GAMES.GG and The Click. The Roblox X teaser could not be directly read. October 22 remains REPORTED; we have not verified an exact launch time, end date or official event hub.

Source-link clarification: the October 13 monitoring report identifies Roblox X post 2108961492187918378 as the teaser cited by Pro Game Guides. Our retained X source points to post 2108226475573096953. These are different posts, and their relationship has not been directly verified. The retained source link should not be read as identifying the teaser reproduced in that article.

Pro Game Guides, updated October 11, reproduces a Roblox teaser dated October 10 pointing to October 22. Its main text gives November 9 as the event end date, while its FAQ gives November 5. Because those dates conflict and primary evidence is missing, neither is published as the event end date.

GAMES.GG, dated October 12, says no participating games are officially confirmed. Its precise start time, end date and virtual-currency reward mechanism remain unverified here. Multiple articles repeating a claim do not replace primary evidence.

The Click, dated October 12, reports a DOORS seasonal event called The Candy Vault, attributed to LSPLASH, scheduled for October 22 at 18:00 UTC. We have not directly verified the underlying Roblox event entry. Shared timing does not demonstrate that DOORS participates in The Hollow, and this time must not be used as The Hollow launch time.

DOORS remains UNCONFIRMED in Community Watch. No games, tasks, badges or rewards have been added to the confirmed directories from these reports. We are watching for explicit Roblox or developer confirmation, a verified hub and documented reward requirements.

title: The Hollow: what we can verify so far
summary: Community reports point to October 22. The game lineup, event hub and reward rules remain unverified.
body: Community discussions dated October 10 describe a Roblox Halloween event called The Hollow and point to October 22, 2026. We are treating the date as reported because the original official X post could not be directly read during this review.
Piggy is mentioned in the announcement discussion. DOORS participation is a separate community theory based on update timing. Neither is included in our confirmed games directory.
An exact launch time, end date, official hub link, quest requirements and reward catalog have not been verified. We will add playable checklists when there is enough evidence to explain what to do.
